steps.note: Start a new event for the end-to-end award flow.
Provide the required event title.
Use an RFQ stage so the event can receive a bid and be awarded.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add a line item required for bidding and awarding.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a bidding schedule so the event can be published.
Invite one QA vendor to provide the required bid.
Publish the test event.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Have the invited QA vendor submit a bid.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Close the event so awarding is available.
Submit the award proposal using the vendor's portal bid.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted award as the buyer.
Open the stage's Order Activity drawer from Settings.
Confirm the activity drawer is open.
Check that the activity view contains submission evidence.
